models.L069: Invented one-locus additive baseline AA18/Aa16/aa14 plus shelter4/exposure0. Not an actual species, gene-expression mechanism or real polygenic quantitative trait. Equal phenotype can have different genotype/environment routes.
models.L070: Not-to-scale structural zoom, local sequence variants and complementary pairing only, no phenotype calculation. Chromosomes include DNA/proteins; replicated state must distinguish sister chromatids. Mitochondria/chloroplasts/bacteria have DNA outside nuclei.
models.L071: Twelve original fictional records. Non-overlapping length bins each4, spot0/1/2 frequencies3/4/5. Rounded continuous records do not become discrete variables. Distributions alone establish neither genetic nor environmental causes.
models.L072: Fictional diploid single locus, one allele per gamete, equally likely gamete positions and random union. Four routes not birth order; no phenotype dominance ranking, linkage or full meiosis. No inference about real complex human traits.
